card.text: Explore Panopaea in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Panopaea is a main-belt asteroid. Explore its calibrated convex reconstruction from DAMIT, version 2023-10-03. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery. Two pole solutions remain; this view uses model 6171.

shape.title: DAMIT model 6171
shape.summary: Shape made from changes in brightness as the asteroid rotates. Gray grid: no surface imagery.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Distance above or below a reference sphere. Colors include the body's shape as well as local terrain.
